d: The Head of Human Resources leads the people agenda for our ambulatory care center in Dubai. The role builds a skilled, engaged and compliant workforce of clinical and non-clinical staff, and acts as a trusted adviser to the CEO and senior leadership team. It also champions Emiratization and the development of UAE national talent in healthcare.
Develop and execute an HR strategy aligned with the center's clinical, operational and growth goals.
Advise leadership on organizational design, workforce planning, succession and change management.
Lead and develop the HR team and manage the HR budget.
Plan and deliver recruitment of physicians, nurses, allied health and administrative staff.
Lead the center's Emiratization plan and meet national workforce targets set by UAE authorities.
Build partnerships with universities, training institutions and national talent programs.
Ensure compliance with UAE Labour Law, MOHRE requirements and Dubai Health Authority (DHA) regulations.
Oversee professional licensing, credentialing, visas, Emirates ID and medical fitness processes.
Maintain HR policies, contracts, and audit readiness for healthcare accreditation (e.g., JCI).
Manage performance, compensation and benefits frameworks that are competitive and fair.
Handle employee relations, grievances and disciplinary matters with discretion.
Promote a culture of patient-centered care, engagement, diversity and retention.
Design training, CME and leadership development programs, including career paths for UAE nationals.
Run onboarding, competency assessments and succession planning for critical roles.
Oversee payroll, HRIS, attendance and rostering for shift-based clinical teams.
Report on headcount, turnover, Emiratization, cost and engagement metrics.
q: UAE National (Emirati) holding a valid Emirati identity; this is a mandatory requirement of the role.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.
Professional certification such as CIPD, SHRM-SCP or SPHR is preferred.
10+ years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 in a senior HR leadership role, ideally in healthcare or hospitality.
Strong knowledge of UAE labour law, DHA and MOHRE processes, and Emiratization policy.
Fluency in English and Arabic, written and spoken.
Strategic thinking and sound business judgment
Influencing and stakeholder management at executive level
Data-driven decision making and strong HRIS skills
Based on site in Dubai with a standard full-time schedule. Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be confirmed in line with UAE regulations and the center's policies.

d: We are looking for Relationship Manager to join our Corporate Sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for expanding our corporate client portfolio, building strong business relationships, identifying new opportunities, and driving revenue growth while ensuring customer satisfaction.
Drive corporate sales growth and achieve assigned sales targets.
Build, manage, and strengthen relationships with existing and potential corporate clients.
Identify new business opportunities and acquire new corporate customers.
Conduct credit assessments and analyze clients' financial statements.
Develop and manage a profitable and diversified corporate credit portfolio.
Collaborate with Risk, Marketing, and Operations teams to ensure smooth business execution.
Monitor market trends and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities.
Maintain high standards of customer satisfaction and service quality.
Prepare periodic reports on portfolio performance, sales activities, and business opportunities.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Commerce, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Corporate Sales within the Financial Services industry.
Strong understanding of corporate financial products, credit analysis, and portfolio management.
Proven track record in corporate client acquisition and relationship management.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
